QuestInfo.name: Dangerous Loyalties 1
QuestInfo.0: You asked #b#p1096006##k, but #b#p1095003##k's bad attitude is getting to you. What's up with her?
QuestInfo.1: A few days ago, #b#p1092003##k professed his undying love to #b#p1090000##k! That's why #b#p1095003##k is in a bad mood. She doesn't want any worthless whales following her captain around, so she wants to make sure #b#p1092003##k isn't a coward. She asks you to collect #rCool Jellyfish Bodies#k and show them to the prince.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p1092003##k has spent his whole life in the sea, so of course he isn't afraid of jellyfish! Let Valerie know that her plan was a failure.

0.0: Hey, you got a minute? I need some #r#o1220003#es#k eliminated. Bring me their Cool Jellyfish Bodies when you're done. And don't ask questions...just do it!
0.1: Listen, I've got a problem. A few days ago, I heard Prince #b#p1092003##k arrived on the Nautilus. Apparently, he came to profess his love for #b#p1090000##k! Some boneheaded adventurer even helped him deliver his gift...
0.2: I'm sure #b#p1090000##k is too good for him, and I want to prove it. You down to help me, #h0#?

yes.0: Most princes are raised in very sheltered environments, so I bet he's a coward. On my honor, I won't allow any coward to even touch our fearless #b#p1090000##k!
yes.1: I want you to collect 30 Cool Jellyfish Bodies, and show them to Prince #b#p1092003##k. That coward will freak as soon as he lays eyes on those squirmy, gooey things!

no.0: Oh, what is this, #h0#? You think Prince #b#p1092003##k should just waltz in here and steal away our #b#p1090000##k? Wait a minute... I bet YOU helped him deliver his gift! Traitor!!

1.0: Oh, hello again, #h0#. I was so tired and stressed last time, I don't think I thanked you properly. I really appreciate everything you've done for me.
1.1: Oh, Cool Jellyfish Bodies! Did you bring these for me? Thank you.

yes.0: What's that look for? I love these things! Back home in the ocean, we eat these all the time. They're great with a little honey mustard.

npc.0: Collect 30 Cool Jellyfish Bodies, show them to Prince #b#p1092003##k, and watch him freak out.

item.0: By the way, what brings you by? Did you have something for me?
